entities.name: Luis Firmín de Carvajal, Conde de la Unión
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luis Fermín de Carvajal, 1st Count of la Unión became a general officer in the army of the Kingdom of Spain. In 1794 during the French Revolutionary Wars, he commanded the Spanish Army in a mostly unsuccessful effort to hold back the army of the First French Republic. He died in battle fighting the French.
